sentences.text: The documents do not state whether a Tier 3 UCB may open a new branch in another state without RBI’s prior approval.

The cited directions apply to all UCBs and say a UCB shall be guided by RBI’s instructions on KYC / AML for opening and operation of accounts, but they do not state any rule here for opening a new branch in another state or for prior approval.
